qa_pairs.question: What are interactive applications on Open OnDemand, and how can a user access them?
qa_pairs.answer: Interactive applications on Open OnDemand are features that allow users to run applications directly from their web browser. To access them, users must navigate to the 'Interactive Apps' tab and select the desired application from the drop-down menu.

qa_pairs.question: What types of job parameters can be specified when submitting an interactive application on Open OnDemand?
qa_pairs.answer: When submitting an interactive application on Open OnDemand, users can choose job parameters such as the length of the job in hours, the number of cores, the amount of memory to allocate (in GB), and GPU resources. Users also have the option to be notified by email when the job starts.
